details: a3f95ac9 project_transcript_page hashes chat_id, IDs, roles and text only; excludes node/instance/account. Same native IDs/content in distinct instances produce same snapshot_id despite distinct source refs. NUL-delimited hashing also allows ambiguous field framing if native text/IDs contain NUL. Browser owner correcting with canonical length-delimited tuple; no live sends needed.
